name: Advancing Front Framework for Implicit Surfaces
definition: An advancing front algorithm that begins with a seed point and grows a triangulation across an implicit surface. The front is the boundary of the already generated mesh. It is advanced by choosing an edge in the front and creating a new triangle attached to it.
summary: The Advancing Front Framework extracts implicit isosurfaces by dynamically growing a triangulated mesh from a seed point, distinguishing itself by operating without pre-defined volume descriptions.
